description: The Royal Government of Bhutan has transferred 490.87 Bitcoin worth $32.74 million (roughly Rs. 3,132 crore) to newly created wallets, according to blockchain analytics firm Onchain Lens. The destinations have not been identified as exchanges or trading firms, meaning the movement does not confirm a sale. The transfer follows several large movements from Bhutan-linked wallets this year, including a 300 BTC transfer on August 18 and a 519.7 BTC transaction in March.
title: Bhutan Transfers 490 Bitcoin Worth $32.7 Million to Fresh Addresses

description: According to a new report, 25th anniversary Xbox Series X25 console will be priced EUR 899.99 in Europe. The console will reportedly launch on November 27, 2026. Microsoft revealed the limited-edition 25th anniversary Xbox console and controller in June.
title: Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition Console Will Reportedly Cost EUR 899.99, Launch on November 27

description: Poco is reportedly preparing two more smartphone launches for India in 2026, with the Poco X8 and Poco X8 Power expected to arrive by early September. Leaked specifications suggest both models will feature large batteries, with the X8 Power potentially offering a 10,000mAh cell and 100W charging. The X8 Power could use Snapdragon 6 Gen 5, while the X8 may feature Snapdragon 6s Gen 4. Both models are expected to sit below the Poco X8 Pro in the lineup.
title: Poco X8 Power, Poco X8 India Launch Timeline, Key Features Leaked

description: New Samsung Galaxy S26 FE renders have surfaced ahead of the company's August 27 Galaxy event, showing the smartphone in Blueberry, Graphite and Pistachio finishes. The images point to a flat-screen design with slim bezels, a centred hole-punch cutout and a triple rear camera system. Earlier leaks have suggested a 6.7-inch 120Hz AMOLED display, Exynos 2500 chipset and 4,900mAh battery with 45W charging. Samsung has not yet officially confirmed the Fan Edition phone's name or launch at the event.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Renders Leak Again, Suggesting Three Colour Options

description: MANTRA Chain has halted network operations while its engineering and security teams investigate an unspecified incident affecting the blockchain. The shutdown has stopped transactions and asset transfers, with validators, public nodes, bridge migration processes, and Inter-Blockchain Communication relays among the affected components. Deposits and withdrawals through affected exchanges have also been paused. MANTRA has not identified the cause, disclosed any stolen or compromised assets, or provided a timeline for restoring network operations.
title: MANTRA Halts Network Transactions Following Unspecified Incident

description: Vivo is gearing up to expand its T-series lineup in India with the upcoming launch of the Vivo T5 5G. The brand’s current portfolio includes three smartphones: Vivo T5 Lite 5G, Vivo T5x 5G, and Vivo T5 Pro 5G, and the company has now announced the impending arrival of the standard T5 model in the country. While its launch date currently remains under wraps, Vivo has begun teasing several of its features.
title: Vivo T5 5G India Launch Confirmed; Flipkart Availability, 3D Curved Display Teased

description: Lava is preparing to add another 5G smartphone to its Virat series in India. The Virat V1 Pro 5G will arrive on August 24 through Flipkart, with its price still under wraps. A report has revealed details including a 6.75-inch 120Hz display, Unisoc T8200 chipset, up to 8GB of RAM and a 50-megapixel rear camera. Lava is also reportedly developing the Virat Curve 5G, which has appeared in the GSMA IMEI Database with model number LXX529.
title: Lava Virat V1 Pro 5G India Launch Date Confirmed, Key Specifications Leaked

description: A new leak has suggested the names of Qualcomm’s upcoming 2nm Snapdragon chipsets.  The SM8950 is tipped to be branded as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, while the chipset codenamed SM8975 is said to be marketed as Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. We can expect more details about the next-generation Snapdragon chipsets to surface online soon. The company will launch the new chipsets at its Snapdragon Summit in Maui, Hawaii, next month.
title: Qualcomm’s Upcoming Flagship Snapdragon Chipset Names Tipped Ahead of Launch

description: The Vivo X500 series is expected to be launched in China soon. While the company has yet to confirm its upcoming flagship lineup, the rumour mill suggests it could include three models — Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Max. Ahead of its anticipated debut, an alleged sighting may have just offered an early look at one of the upcoming Pro models. One of the Vivo X500 Pro models was reportedly seen recently during the filming of an advertisement.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Series Model Allegedly Spotted in the Wild Ahead of China Launch

description: Krafton India released a fresh set of redeem codes for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) on Friday. The BGMI redeem codes allow players to unlock Cyber Icon - Vector and other limited-time in-game rewards for free. A total of 50 redeem codes have been released, which can be claimed through BGMI's official redemption website. The latest code drop arrives as part of the game's 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update, which introduced CarryMinati as a playable character, a custom World of Wonder map, and a dedicated Boss Battle.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for August 21 Released: How to Claim Cyber Icon Vector Skin, Other Free Rewards

description: Two Binance employees were reportedly detained or questioned by UAE authorities in recent weeks during an investigation into financial activity linked to a Binance client account, The New York Times reported. Binance said a small number of employees were asked to provide statements about third-party funding flows and were promptly cleared and released. The exchange said the employees were not targets of the investigation and that it was cooperating with Dubai Police and other UAE authorities.
title: Binance Employees Detained in UAE, Exchange Says Staff Were Cleared and Released

description: AI features are now a baseline expectation for the majority of smartphone buyers in India, reveals Amazon's Best in Tech Survey. The survey conducted by Amazon drew more than 40,000 responses across all major consumer electronics categories. Battery life stands out as both the most-wanted quality and the most common shortfall. One in three buyers is considering spending Rs. 50,000 or more for their next smartphone. 15 percent is looking at phones priced between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 75,000, and 17 percent is considering devices above Rs. 75,000.
title: AI Is Key Smartphone Buying Factor for 82 Percent of Indian Consumers, Shows Amazon Survey

description: In recent years, Google has increasingly been positioning its flagship Pixel phones around Gemini, its multimodal artificial intelligence chatbot. As the Mountain View-based tech giant continues to push AI across more of its products and services, the effect is now being strongly observed, especially on the new Pixel 11 series. There appears to be a noticeable change to its startup sequence, which marks a departure from a message that has appeared on Pixel phones for many years.
title: Google Pixel 11 Boot Screen Drops ‘Powered by Android’ for Gemini, and the Symbolism Is Huge

description: Slack has introduced Slack Code, a new way for teams and AI coding agents to build software together in the open. The new feature brings coding agents directly into dedicated code channels. With this update, teammates can collaborate with AI agents on projects, review code, see live previews and provide feedback, all within Slack. The feature now supports agents from Anthropic's Claude Code, Cognition's Devin, GitHub Copilot, and Vercel.
title: Slack Announces Slack Code to Bring AI Coding Agents Directly Into Team Collaboration

description: 007 First Light has hit an impressive new sales milestone. The James Bond action-adventure title has surpassed 4 million copies sold in three months of launch, IO Interactive announced Thursday. The game had sold 1.5 million copies in just 24 hours after it released on May 27.
title: IO Interactive Says 007 First Light Has Sold 4 Million Copies in 3 Months

description: Google's Pause Point feature adds a short interruption before users open apps they have marked as distracting. The Android 17 tool starts a 10-second countdown and requires users to opt in. While Google's Android video describes it as available on select Android 17 devices, its support page currently lists the Pixel 11 series. The company has not confirmed whether older Pixel phones or other Android 17 devices will receive the feature. The Pixel 11 lineup launched in India earlier this month.
title: Android 17 Pause Point May Be Limited to Pixel 11 Series, Google Says

description: Apple's annual September event is just weeks away. While anticipation has been building for the next-generation iPhones, the rumour mill widely suggests that one of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s most important products could be missing from the showcase. Apple has been rumoured to adopt a staggered launch strategy this year, with only the iPhone 18 Pro models debuting alongside the Ultra. The standard iPhone model, meanwhile, could be pushed into early 2027.
title: Waiting for iPhone 18? Launch Could Be Months Away as Apple Splits its iPhone Releases

description: Pova 8 Pro 5G is now available for purchase in India. The handset was launched on Tuesday as the latest addition to the Pova 8 series. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chipset and sports a 144Hz AMOLED screen. The company has equipped it with an Alive Matrix Display on the rear, which can show notifications, battery status, timers, and other information. The Pova 8 Pro 5G packs a 6,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging.
title: Pova 8 Pro 5G With Alive Matrix Display, 50-Megapixel Sony Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Beats 360 headphones have been spotted on the ANATEL regulatory database in Brazil with the model number A3577, according to a report. The report highlights that the model number belongs to the Beats 360 headphones. The listing suggests that Apple could be gearing up to launch the new Beats over-the-ear headphones soon in select global markets, including Brazil. This comes shortly after the Beats 360 was spotted on the US FCC database with the model number A5377, which described it as Bluetooth over-ear headphones. Recently, another report highlighted that the Beats 360 has been listed on Amazon in the UK, revealing the upcoming headphones’ key details.
title: Beats 360 Headphones Spotted on Brazil's ANATEL Database, Hinting at Imminent Launch

description: A triathlon runner named Connor underwent open-heart surgery after an ECG reading from his Apple Watch led doctors to investigate an underlying congenital heart condition. Connor had noticed his heart rate reaching about 219 beats per minute during a triathlon. The ECG showed signs of atrial fibrillation, prompting further medical checks. Apple has now featured his experience in a YouTube video as part of its series highlighting user experiences with Apple Watch health and safety features, including ECG and Fall Detection.
title: Apple Watch ECG Flags Atrial Fibrillation in Runner: Here's What Happened Next
Samsung Galaxy A Price Drop Alert: What Buyers Should Check Before Buying

description: Redmi Watch 6 Active launched in China with a 1.85-inch AMOLED display. It offers a Bluetooth calling feature and supports more than 140 sports modes. It has an IP68-rated build. It provides heart rate monitoring and has a 470 mAh battery inside that is claimed to last up to 18 days on a single charge. It is currently available for purchase in China in Gunmetal, Pink Orange, and Silver colourways.
title: Redmi Watch 6 Active Announced With 1.85-Inch AMOLED Display, Over 140 Sports Modes: Price, Specifications

description: Sennheiser has introduced the Momentum True Wireless 5 in select global markets, adding replaceable batteries to its latest flagship earbuds. The model supports aptX Lossless, Dolby Atmos with head tracking and Bluetooth 6.0, alongside adaptive ANC and AI-based voice isolation. Each earbud delivers up to 12 hours of playback, while the case extends total battery life to 40 hours. The earbuds also feature an IP54-rated design, multipoint connectivity and customisation through the Smart Control Plus app.
title: Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 Launched With Replaceable Batteries, Up to 40 Hours Total Battery Life

description: Poco M8x 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the Xiaomi sub-brand mid-range Poco M8 lineup. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in India on August 27 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart. The Poco M8x 5G is offered in Black, Blue, and Leather Green colour options. The phone ships with Xiaomi’s latest Android 16-based HyperOS 3. The tech firm promises four OS upgrades and six years of security updates for the handset. It sports a 6.9-inch HD+ LCD touchscreen, offering up to 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Poco M8x 5G Launched in India With 7,900mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has suffered a string of leaks this week, showing alleged gameplay footage from the title. The latest leaked video suggests the leaker may have access to a working build of GTA 6. Rockstar and Take Take have not yet released an official statement on the leaks.
title: Latest GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Suggests Leaker Could Have Playable Build of the Game

description: Bitcoin climbed above Rs. 72 lakh as improving liquidity, stronger institutional demand and a sharp unwinding of bearish positions fuelled a broader cryptocurrency market rally. Ethereum and XRP also posted strong gains, although analysts cautioned investors against chasing the rapid move.
title: Bitcoin Crosses $75,000 as $3 Billion in Short Positions Liquidated Amid Crypto Rally

description: Apple could launch its Apple Watch Series 12 with a ceramic casing. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has also previously claimed that Apple will bring back ceramic case options for its Apple Watch series, which could be launched later this year or in 2027. Apple Watch Edition Series 5, released in 2019, is the last Apple wearable to feature a ceramic finish.
title: Apple Watch Series 12 Could Get Ceramic Case, New Leak Suggests

description: Apple's annual September event is just weeks away. While anticipation has been building for the next-generation iPhones, the rumour mill widely suggests that one of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s most important products could be missing from the showcase. Apple has been rumoured to adopt a staggered launch strategy this year, with only the iPhone 18 Pro models debuting alongside the Ultra. The standard iPhone model, meanwhile, could be pushed into early 2027.
title: Waiting for iPhone 18? Launch Could Be Months Away as Apple Splits its iPhone Releases

description: Nothing has announced that it will unveil the Android 17-based Nothing OS 5.0 version on August 25 at 11:00 am BST (3:30 pm IST). While the video teaser does not reveal any details about the upcoming major firmware update, it does hint at a few design changes, including new icons and widgets. The Nothing OS 5.0 will be based on the latest Android 17 update, which means it could bring new features as part of the OS upgrade. The UK-based tech firm is also expected to announce its Nothing OS 5.0 beta programme on the same day.
title: Nothing to Unveil Android 17-Based Nothing OS 5.0 Next Week: Expected Features

description: Nike announced a new addition to its long-running Pegasus lineup with the launch of the Pegasus Plus 2 on Thursday. It is positioned as a tempo trainer. As per the company, the running shoe delivers a combination of a visible, curved Air Zoom unit in the forefoot and a responsive ZoomX foam midsole, courtesy of which it can deliver 18 percent more energy return than the first-generation Pegasus Plus. Nike’s latest show features refined MR10 2.0 last, a roomier forefoot and toe box, pressure-tuned Air Zoom technology, and a modern waffle outsole with new flex zones.
title: Nike Pegasus Plus 2 Launched With Curved Air Zoom Unit, ZoomX Midsole Tech

description: Google has started rolling out a new Android Auto update to fix various issues previously reported by users, the Android Auto community specialist Venkatesh announced while replying to user complaints on the support page. The latest firmware version resolves a major issue that caused Android Auto to keep disconnecting from the user’s phone. In some instances, the bug also caused the Android Auto screen to completely freeze, rendering it unusable. The community specialist advises users facing the problem to update their Android Auto app to the latest firmware version, Android Auto 17.4 or a newer version. He highlights that after updating to the newest version, the issue should be resolved.
title: Android Auto Connection Problem Resolved With the Latest Update, Google Says
